draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.38, the 28th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 4th of 37 at CB. He went 23rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jaylon Johnson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2021, 18th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers (practice squad). 43 career games and 19 starts over 4 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: completion % allowed 51.9% (89th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 48.6% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
